title: I LOVE The Scent but Not The Price
text: I LOVE The Scent but Not The Price. I LOVE LOVE LOVE the Westin Scent. A few years ago I was tempted to spend the gigantic price for this scent.  I would have never told anyone that I paid this big price tag though.  It's just a candle. I bought the Candle Bay version and it is virtually identical.  I have been buying this scent from Candle Bay for Years.  I purchase 10 White Tea Candles from Candle Bay twice a year at a fraction of the price. The customer service at Candle Bay is exceptional!

product_metadata.title: Westin White Tea Candle - Hand-Poured, Soy Candle with Signature White Tea Scent -12.5 oz. - Set of 2
features: WESTIN HOTEL EXCLUSIVE - The signature Westin White Tea scent is exclusively featured in Westin Hotels & Resorts worldwide. Now, with our Westin White Tea Collection, you can bring the signature scent home.
HAND-POURED - Our candles are hand-poured using 100% all-natural soy for a cleaner, soot-free burn. The classic white jar adds a touch of elegant style to any space.
SIGNATURE WESTIN SCENT - Sweet white tea is infused with notes of warm vanilla and woodsy cedar for a soothing, invigorating scent that transforms your home.
LONG LASTING - Each Westin White Tea Candle burns for approximately 60 hours to fill your home with long-lasting fragrance.
INCLUDES - Set of 2 12.5-ounce hand-poured Westin White Tea Candles
